text.description_html:
Acorn IR9BP, 4" Hand Forged Black Iron Art Cabinet Pull

Acorn's 4" Iron Art Cabinet Pull was made by hand in a forge using a hammer and anvil. It is perfect for rustic decors. The black finish mimics the texture of naturally weathered iron thus granting it an old world feel that will accent country styles as well as colonial restorations. This cabinet pull is the perfect way to bring in the beautiful textures and handmade charm that hardware had back when all iron was shaped by a blacksmith's hand without dating the space too much; because even through the 4" Hand Forged Iron Art Cabinet Pull draws on the old world, it still manages to feel very now.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the 4 Inch Hand Forged Iron Art Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 4"
  • Projection: 1-3/4"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
